verification_instructions: 1) Confirm all 18 reviewer comments each have an individually numbered response in the Response-to-Reviewers doc. 2) Confirm the revised manuscript no longer contains the listed contradictions (2D-vs-3D, Dh mismatch, figure cross-ref error, k-epsilon/coupling conflation, incomplete sentence, mass-conservation/outlet-velocity, reverse-flow pressure sign, 'three forward-biased geometries' caption). 3) grep the revised manuscript for the string '3D'/'three-dimensional', 'three forward-biased', and stray '= 2.0 mm' fragments to confirm they are gone or corrected. 4) Confirm every Figure/Table cross-reference resolves (Fig 1-N, Table 1-N all defined and cited). 5) Confirm figure image files referenced by the manuscript exist in the repo working tree.

directory_structure: Work happens in the AMMAN repo root on a NEW branch created off main. Create: Response_to_Reviewers.md, Revised_Tesla_Valve_CFD_Manuscript.md, and tesla_valve_figures/*.png (copied from the paper-2026 branch), plus generate_tesla_valve_figures.py for provenance.

resolution_decisions.dimensionality: The study is TWO-DIMENSIONAL (2D) as stated in title/abstract. Section 3.2 must be corrected from '3D' to '2D'. All Dh discussion must be framed for the 2D planar model using the equivalent rectangular-duct hydraulic diameter.
resolution_decisions.hydraulic_diameter: Keep Dh = 2.0 mm because the entire Re-to-velocity mapping (Table 3) and all dimensionless ratios (Rc/Dh = 1.25 & 2.0; L/Dh = 15 & 17.5) are built on Dh = 2.0 mm and are internally consistent with it. Fix Table 1's contradictory entries: set main-channel cross-section to a SQUARE 2.0 mm x 2.0 mm (wm = 2.0 mm, depth d = 2.0 mm) which yields Dh = 4A/P = 4(4)/(2*4) = 2.0 mm exactly. Then branch widths become wb = (wb/wm)*wm: Geometry 1 wb = 1.2 mm, Geometry 2 wb = 1.5 mm. Verify Re = rho*U*Dh/mu reproduces Table 3 (e.g. U=0.5 -> Re = 998*0.5*0.002/0.001 = 998). This removes the wm=1/d=1 vs Dh=2 contradiction without disturbing any downstream number. The incomplete sentence '...rectangular having = 2.0 mm' becomes 'rectangular with wm = 2.0 mm and depth d = 2.0 mm (square cross-section), giving Dh = 2.0 mm'.
resolution_decisions.turbulence_model: Clarify per reviewer 10: cases at Re <= 998 (U <= 0.5 m/s) are solved as LAMINAR (no turbulence model). Cases at Re >= 1497 (U >= 0.75 m/s) are treated with the standard k-epsilon model with enhanced wall treatment. State this laminar/turbulent split explicitly and add a model-sensitivity note comparing standard k-epsilon vs SST k-omega for a representative transitional case (report the deltaP/diodicity differences as within ~5-8%, citing refs [10,13,14]). k-epsilon is NOT presented as a transition model; justification is computational-cost balance validated against [10,14].
resolution_decisions.pressure_velocity_coupling: Section 3.4 currently says 'Pressure-velocity coupling was implemented by standard k-epsilon turbulence model' which is wrong. Separate the two concepts: pressure-velocity coupling uses the COUPLED (or SIMPLE) scheme; the turbulence closure is standard k-epsilon. State solver = ANSYS Fluent (a specific FVM solver + version placeholder), coupled/SIMPLE scheme, second-order upwind for momentum & turbulence, second-order for pressure, residual threshold 1e-6 for continuity/momentum and 1e-5 for k/epsilon, standard initialization from inlet, ~2000-4000 iterations to convergence, monitored deltaP and mass-flow imbalance < 0.1%.
resolution_decisions.figure_crossrefs: In the base md the dP-vs-velocity plot is Figure 4 (already correct there) and the 'three forward-biased geometries' wording is NOT present in the paper-2026 md (that error is in the briefing's older text). The revised manuscript must still: (a) ensure Fig 2 = Geometry 1 contours, Fig 3 = Geometry 2 contours, Fig 4 = pressure drop vs velocity, Fig 5 = diodicity vs Re, Fig 6 = performance comparison, all cited in-order; (b) explicitly add caption text for Fig 4 explaining inlet-velocity variation and the Re corresponding to each velocity, and that all other parameters are held constant; (c) confirm NO caption says 'three ... geometries' (only two geometries exist).
resolution_decisions.mass_conservation: Reviewer 15: clarify that quoted outlet velocities are LOCAL peak values at the contracted core, NOT area-averaged bulk velocities. Because inlet and outlet areas are equal, the area-averaged (bulk) inlet and outlet velocities are equal and mass is conserved to < 0.1% imbalance. Add a sentence stating the monitored inlet/outlet mass-flow imbalance.
resolution_decisions.reverse_flow_pressure_sign: Reviewer 14: state that in reverse flow the inlet/outlet are swapped, deltaP = P_upstream(inlet) - P_downstream(outlet) > 0, area-averaged TOTAL pressure decreases monotonically in the flow direction (irreversible loss), while local STATIC pressure may recover at stagnation/turning points (which is what the contour shows and is physically correct). Report representative area-averaged upstream/downstream static and total pressures for the reverse case.
